caption: The drawing depicts a scene on a light-colored background, primarily featuring a landscape with various natural elements. In the foreground, two brown deer are present; one is leaping while the other is lying down. There are two large trees in the midsection: the left tree has yellowish-green leaves and acorns, while the right tree has broader green leaves and clusters of red berries. In the background, two stylized trees with green and red foliage are depicted on a small mound, and there are bare, thin branches or small trees scattered throughout. A butterfly with blue, pink, and purple wings appears near the top center, and above it, an insect with yellow wings and a curled tail is shown. The ground area consists of a wavy, green terrain with tufts of grass and scattered red and yellow flowers. The composition is relatively symmetrical, with the animals and trees balanced on either side of the central area, and the overall color scheme consists of greens, browns, yellows, reds, and a pale blue background.
